name: Wave C after wave B
idea: A signal when the wave B pullback of a correction may be over and wave C may be starting, by the trigger style you pick; wave C may run against the higher trend.

params.label: Wave timeframe
params.help: The chart where the waves are counted (the minor trend). Not finer than your signal timeframe.

params.label: Higher timeframe
params.help: The chart of the main trend. Not finer than the wave timeframe.

params.label: Wave size
params.help: Which swings count as waves: 1 is the smallest, 3 the largest. Larger waves need more history.

params.label: Smaller swing size
params.help: The smaller swings inside a wave: they mark the area, the turn of the smaller structure and each new pullback. Smaller than the wave size.

params.label: Higher trend
params.help: Wave C may run against the higher trend, so this template allows it by default; pick the first choice to keep only C legs with the higher trend.
choice_labels: Only with the higher trend
Also against the higher trend (a counter-trend C leg)

params.label: Higher trend swing size
params.help: Which swings on the higher timeframe decide its trend: 0 is the smallest, 3 the largest.

params.label: Trigger style
params.help: What turns the setup into a signal. The touch and candle styles look for the area; the others for the smaller structure or the wave's own channel.
choice_labels: The first touch of the area
A reversal candle at the area
The smaller structure turns on your chart
A close beyond the channel of the pullback
The retest of the broken channel

params.label: Area
params.help: Where the touch and candle styles look for the end of the pullback: the zone of the last smaller swing, or no area (then turn on the Fibonacci zone).
choice_labels: Smaller swing zones
No area

params.label: Area width
params.help: How close to the zone the close must be, in median bar ranges.

params.label: Wave A
params.help: Only when wave A changed the swing structure on the wave timeframe (it is no longer pointing against wave C), or any wave A.
choice_labels: Only when wave A changed the structure
Any wave A

params.label: Fibonacci zone
params.help: Only when wave B has retraced wave A into this zone (shares of wave A).
choice_labels: Off
Only inside the zone

params.label: Wave B depth: from
params.help: The near edge of the zone, as a share of the wave it is measured against.

params.label: Wave B depth: to
params.help: The far edge of the zone, as a share of the wave it is measured against.

params.label: Count clarity
params.help: An unclear count never gives a signal. Optionally also skip a count whose alternate reading points the other way.
choice_labels: Any count that is not unclear
Not when the alternate count points the other way

params.label: Opportunities
params.help: Only the first opportunity in each wave B, or a new one at every new smaller swing inside it (the newest replaces the older one).
choice_labels: Only the first one per wave
Every new smaller pullback inside the wave

params.label: Pullback watch
params.help: With every new smaller pullback: how many bars of your chart each one is watched for its trigger.

params.label: Break distance
params.help: How far beyond the level a close must be, in average true ranges (0 means any close beyond).

params.label: Retest window
params.help: For the retest style: the bars after the break within which the retest must come.

params.label: The idea is wrong beyond
params.help: The count's own limit (the start of wave A, or the end of wave B if B went past it), the last smaller swing, the far side of the area (the zone of the last smaller swing, widened by the area width), or whichever of the count's limit and the area's far side is further.
choice_labels: The start of wave A, or wave B's end beyond it
The last smaller swing
The far side of the area
Whichever is further: the count's limit or the area's far side

params.label: Exit signal
params.help: Optional: when the idea has ended. It is not acted on yet; your own exit settings always apply.
choice_labels: None
The wave structure turns against the idea
The count leaves waves B and C

params.label: RSI divergence
params.help: Optional: also an RSI divergence on the wave chart when the trigger comes. Regular: the last swing went further than the one before but the RSI did not. Hidden: the last swing stopped short of the one before but the RSI went further.
choice_labels: Off
A regular divergence
A hidden divergence

params.label: Divergence swing size
params.help: Which swings of the wave chart the divergence compares: 0 is the smallest (the swings inside a wave); a larger size compares larger swings, up to the waves themselves.

params.label: Divergence age
params.help: How many bars of the wave chart before the trigger the divergence's last swing may be.

params.label: RSI length
params.help: How many bars the RSI of the divergence is measured over.

params.label: Volume
params.help: Optional: wave B on lower volume than wave A, the trigger bar on higher volume than its average, or both. Indices have no volume: leave this off for an index (it would never confirm).
choice_labels: Off
Wave B on lower volume than wave A
The trigger bar on higher volume
Both

params.label: Trigger bar volume
params.help: For the trigger bar volume: at least this many times its average volume.

constraints.message: The wave timeframe must not be finer than your signal timeframe.
The higher timeframe must not be finer than the wave timeframe.
The smaller swings must be smaller than the waves.
The Fibonacci zone must start before it ends.
Pick an area or turn on the Fibonacci zone: the touch and candle styles need one.

first.long: (WaveState($wave_degree)@{wave_tf} == "COR_B" OR (WaveState($wave_degree)@{wave_tf} == "COR_C" AND WaveEnd($wave_degree, "current")@{wave_tf} <= WaveEnd($wave_degree, "A")@{wave_tf})) AND WaveEnd($wave_degree, "A")@{wave_tf} > WaveOrigin($wave_degree)@{wave_tf} AND WaveType($wave_degree)@{wave_tf} != "DOUBLE" AND ($a_structure == "any" OR DowTrend($wave_degree)@{wave_tf} != "DOWN") AND (WaveClarity($wave_degree)@{wave_tf} != "UNCLEAR" AND ($min_clarity == "any" OR WaveClarity($wave_degree)@{wave_tf} != "ALT_DISAGREES")) AND ($fib_zone == "none" OR (WaveState($wave_degree)@{wave_tf} == "COR_B" AND WaveRatio($wave_degree)@{wave_tf} >= $fib_from AND WaveRatio($wave_degree)@{wave_tf} <= $fib_to) OR (WaveState($wave_degree)@{wave_tf} == "COR_C" AND (WaveEnd($wave_degree, "A")@{wave_tf} - WaveEnd($wave_degree, "B")@{wave_tf}) / (WaveEnd($wave_degree, "A")@{wave_tf} - WaveOrigin($wave_degree)@{wave_tf}) >= $fib_from AND (WaveEnd($wave_degree, "A")@{wave_tf} - WaveEnd($wave_degree, "B")@{wave_tf}) / (WaveEnd($wave_degree, "A")@{wave_tf} - WaveOrigin($wave_degree)@{wave_tf}) <= $fib_to))
first.short: (WaveState($wave_degree)@{wave_tf} == "COR_B" OR (WaveState($wave_degree)@{wave_tf} == "COR_C" AND WaveEnd($wave_degree, "current")@{wave_tf} >= WaveEnd($wave_degree, "A")@{wave_tf})) AND WaveEnd($wave_degree, "A")@{wave_tf} < WaveOrigin($wave_degree)@{wave_tf} AND WaveType($wave_degree)@{wave_tf} != "DOUBLE" AND ($a_structure == "any" OR DowTrend($wave_degree)@{wave_tf} != "UP") AND (WaveClarity($wave_degree)@{wave_tf} != "UNCLEAR" AND ($min_clarity == "any" OR WaveClarity($wave_degree)@{wave_tf} != "ALT_DISAGREES")) AND ($fib_zone == "none" OR (WaveState($wave_degree)@{wave_tf} == "COR_B" AND WaveRatio($wave_degree)@{wave_tf} >= $fib_from AND WaveRatio($wave_degree)@{wave_tf} <= $fib_to) OR (WaveState($wave_degree)@{wave_tf} == "COR_C" AND (WaveEnd($wave_degree, "A")@{wave_tf} - WaveEnd($wave_degree, "B")@{wave_tf}) / (WaveEnd($wave_degree, "A")@{wave_tf} - WaveOrigin($wave_degree)@{wave_tf}) >= $fib_from AND (WaveEnd($wave_degree, "A")@{wave_tf} - WaveEnd($wave_degree, "B")@{wave_tf}) / (WaveEnd($wave_degree, "A")@{wave_tf} - WaveOrigin($wave_degree)@{wave_tf}) <= $fib_to))

every.long: (WaveState($wave_degree)@{wave_tf} == "COR_B" OR (WaveState($wave_degree)@{wave_tf} == "COR_C" AND WaveEnd($wave_degree, "current")@{wave_tf} <= WaveEnd($wave_degree, "A")@{wave_tf})) AND WaveEnd($wave_degree, "A")@{wave_tf} > WaveOrigin($wave_degree)@{wave_tf} AND WaveType($wave_degree)@{wave_tf} != "DOUBLE" AND ($a_structure == "any" OR DowTrend($wave_degree)@{wave_tf} != "DOWN") AND (WaveClarity($wave_degree)@{wave_tf} != "UNCLEAR" AND ($min_clarity == "any" OR WaveClarity($wave_degree)@{wave_tf} != "ALT_DISAGREES")) AND ($fib_zone == "none" OR (WaveState($wave_degree)@{wave_tf} == "COR_B" AND WaveRatio($wave_degree)@{wave_tf} >= $fib_from AND WaveRatio($wave_degree)@{wave_tf} <= $fib_to) OR (WaveState($wave_degree)@{wave_tf} == "COR_C" AND (WaveEnd($wave_degree, "A")@{wave_tf} - WaveEnd($wave_degree, "B")@{wave_tf}) / (WaveEnd($wave_degree, "A")@{wave_tf} - WaveOrigin($wave_degree)@{wave_tf}) >= $fib_from AND (WaveEnd($wave_degree, "A")@{wave_tf} - WaveEnd($wave_degree, "B")@{wave_tf}) / (WaveEnd($wave_degree, "A")@{wave_tf} - WaveOrigin($wave_degree)@{wave_tf}) <= $fib_to)) AND (SwingLow($area_degree)@{wave_tf} < Lag(SwingLow($area_degree)@{wave_tf}, 1) OR SwingLow($area_degree)@{wave_tf} > Lag(SwingLow($area_degree)@{wave_tf}, 1))
every.short: (WaveState($wave_degree)@{wave_tf} == "COR_B" OR (WaveState($wave_degree)@{wave_tf} == "COR_C" AND WaveEnd($wave_degree, "current")@{wave_tf} >= WaveEnd($wave_degree, "A")@{wave_tf})) AND WaveEnd($wave_degree, "A")@{wave_tf} < WaveOrigin($wave_degree)@{wave_tf} AND WaveType($wave_degree)@{wave_tf} != "DOUBLE" AND ($a_structure == "any" OR DowTrend($wave_degree)@{wave_tf} != "UP") AND (WaveClarity($wave_degree)@{wave_tf} != "UNCLEAR" AND ($min_clarity == "any" OR WaveClarity($wave_degree)@{wave_tf} != "ALT_DISAGREES")) AND ($fib_zone == "none" OR (WaveState($wave_degree)@{wave_tf} == "COR_B" AND WaveRatio($wave_degree)@{wave_tf} >= $fib_from AND WaveRatio($wave_degree)@{wave_tf} <= $fib_to) OR (WaveState($wave_degree)@{wave_tf} == "COR_C" AND (WaveEnd($wave_degree, "A")@{wave_tf} - WaveEnd($wave_degree, "B")@{wave_tf}) / (WaveEnd($wave_degree, "A")@{wave_tf} - WaveOrigin($wave_degree)@{wave_tf}) >= $fib_from AND (WaveEnd($wave_degree, "A")@{wave_tf} - WaveEnd($wave_degree, "B")@{wave_tf}) / (WaveEnd($wave_degree, "A")@{wave_tf} - WaveOrigin($wave_degree)@{wave_tf}) <= $fib_to)) AND (SwingHigh($area_degree)@{wave_tf} < Lag(SwingHigh($area_degree)@{wave_tf}, 1) OR SwingHigh($area_degree)@{wave_tf} > Lag(SwingHigh($area_degree)@{wave_tf}, 1))

candle.long: WaveState($wave_degree)@{wave_tf} == "COR_B" AND ($area_source == "none" OR (SwingZoneDistance("low", $area_degree)@{wave_tf} <= $zone_width AND SwingZoneDistance("low", $area_degree)@{wave_tf} >= -$zone_width)) AND ReversalAt(WaveEnd($wave_degree, "current")@{wave_tf}, "bullish")
candle.short: WaveState($wave_degree)@{wave_tf} == "COR_B" AND ($area_source == "none" OR (SwingZoneDistance("high", $area_degree)@{wave_tf} <= $zone_width AND SwingZoneDistance("high", $area_degree)@{wave_tf} >= -$zone_width)) AND ReversalAt(WaveEnd($wave_degree, "current")@{wave_tf}, "bearish")

choch.long: (WaveState($wave_degree)@{wave_tf} == "COR_B" OR (WaveState($wave_degree)@{wave_tf} == "COR_C" AND WaveEnd($wave_degree, "current")@{wave_tf} <= WaveEnd($wave_degree, "A")@{wave_tf})) AND SwingBreakType("up", $area_degree, $k) == "CHOCH"
choch.short: (WaveState($wave_degree)@{wave_tf} == "COR_B" OR (WaveState($wave_degree)@{wave_tf} == "COR_C" AND WaveEnd($wave_degree, "current")@{wave_tf} >= WaveEnd($wave_degree, "A")@{wave_tf})) AND SwingBreakType("down", $area_degree, $k) == "CHOCH"

breakout.long: (WaveState($wave_degree)@{wave_tf} == "COR_B" OR (WaveState($wave_degree)@{wave_tf} == "COR_C" AND WaveEnd($wave_degree, "current")@{wave_tf} <= WaveEnd($wave_degree, "A")@{wave_tf})) AND WaveLineBreak($wave_degree, "channel_B", "up", $k)@{wave_tf}
breakout.short: (WaveState($wave_degree)@{wave_tf} == "COR_B" OR (WaveState($wave_degree)@{wave_tf} == "COR_C" AND WaveEnd($wave_degree, "current")@{wave_tf} >= WaveEnd($wave_degree, "A")@{wave_tf})) AND WaveLineBreak($wave_degree, "channel_B", "down", $k)@{wave_tf}

retest.long: (WaveState($wave_degree)@{wave_tf} == "COR_B" OR (WaveState($wave_degree)@{wave_tf} == "COR_C" AND WaveEnd($wave_degree, "current")@{wave_tf} <= WaveEnd($wave_degree, "A")@{wave_tf})) AND RetestEntry("up", "wave_line", $retest_bars, true, $wave_degree, "channel_B", "A", $k)@{wave_tf}
retest.short: (WaveState($wave_degree)@{wave_tf} == "COR_B" OR (WaveState($wave_degree)@{wave_tf} == "COR_C" AND WaveEnd($wave_degree, "current")@{wave_tf} >= WaveEnd($wave_degree, "A")@{wave_tf})) AND RetestEntry("down", "wave_line", $retest_bars, true, $wave_degree, "channel_B", "A", $k)@{wave_tf}
